case_policy: 50 frozen baseline observations: 20 spec x original/reversed, 10 diagnostic original; full 30-key state and all candidates unchanged
performance_policy: S03; one warmup; full30 and actual single-key serial each repeated3, alternating order
selection_policy: Measure both speed and all baseline cases. Prefer zero choice changes for runtime-only optimizations; reject regressions on previously correct cases. Do not promote a mode change without quality evidence. Keep full state/candidates. Roll back failed startup.
